cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says lawyers or litigants can file with the courts online.
cells.note: UNDP says SIGAJ, a judicial case management system, was introduced in the justice sector by 2024 (COD-002), so case management is in service. Commercial-court and interconnection work (COD-001, COD-003) is under way, and nothing says cases can be filed online.
